entrypoint.requirement: A single Authority-controlled HTTPS entrypoint must serve the public onboarding page and submit consented admission requests to the Authority.

terminology.passive_mirror_client: A registered client instance with read-only access to explicitly public or separately granted information; not a Git repository Mirror and not an Authority peer.
terminology.repository_mirror: The separately governed Git repository Goldkelch/qik-vrt.

telemetry.page_view: Aggregate, privacy-minimized server telemetry only where the hosting platform exposes it; never claim every click is observed.
telemetry.admission_request: Explicit POST after informed user consent, with request_id, timestamp, entrypoint_version, client_type_claim, and requested_scope.

access.access_scope: Public repository and explicitly published mesh documents only, unless a separate grant is recorded.

deployment_gates: Authority-controlled public HTTPS host is identified and under Owner control
Consent UI and admission endpoint are deployed
POST request is durably recorded by Authority and independently read back
Admission receipt is bound to exact Authority head and tree
Read-only scope is enforced by the serving layer
Privacy, abuse, retention, withdrawal and failure tests pass
Fresh external request and readback are verified
non_claims: A GitHub blob or raw URL cannot report every click to the Authority.
A page view does not identify a person or prove that an AI client loaded or understood the content.
A client is not admitted merely by opening the entrypoint.
A registered passive reader is not a Git repository Mirror, Authority, writer, or executor.
This contract does not claim that the endpoint or public host is deployed.
